top_signal.title: Need help with customer acquisition B2B
top_signal.summary: Hello all,   I started a medical supply/distribution business back in March. Since then, I have grown my catalog from around 20-30 SKUs to over 2,000. Our pricing is pretty competitive compared to other places, and I've saved a few customers quite a bit of money. The problem is I don't really know how to acquire customers that well. I have around 5 to 6 recurring customers so far, which isn't the best, but I'm grateful for them. How do I go about getting more b2b customers? I've done over 100 walk-ins, which have resulted in 0 customers. I've cold called/emailed hundreds as well which landed me about 3 out of my 6 customers. Any suggestions from anyone in the b2b space?    Would appreciate anyone's opinions/comments. Thank you!       submitted by     /u/Personal_Barber_7564       [link]       [comments]
